results.name: Valencia
results.note: Written by the interrupted run (09:18); verified complete and consistent this run (sidecar reconstructs to 41.9 via computeCompositeFromDimensions; proposal status pending; 40 proposed_subdimensions; disclaimer present). Not modified.
results.key_finding: First evidence-based baseline of the municipal row: in-window flood response by the city credited, but homeless provision and accountability gaps put Valencia at 41.9, not the unassessed 60.9; regional (Generalitat) conduct excluded.

results.name: Egypt
results.key_finding: Six Matsda2sh investigative journalists arrested 28-29 September 2026 with no reasons given (CPJ); Transparency falls 2 -> 1, the only affected measure not already at the floor; 21.3, still Developing.

results.name: Spain
results.key_finding: Two Royal Decree-laws (29 September 2026) extend eviction protection to 2030 and are credited, but anchors already reflected them; measures 51.2, corroborating the pending spain-2026-08-26 proposal (50.6); not duplicated.
results.withheld_reason: A pending proposal for the same entity (research/change-proposals/spain-2026-08-26.json, 60.0 -> 50.6) has not been reviewed. This cycle measures 51.2, within 0.6 of it. Filing a duplicate would add a second unreviewed queue item for the same finding.

results.name: Delta Air Lines
results.key_finding: $78.7M fuel-dump settlement tentatively approved 28 September 2026 while Delta still denies wrongdoing; Harm Acknowledgment 3 -> 2; 61.3 confirms 62.5.

results.name: Pakistan
results.key_finding: Near-floor: the 2026-08-20 sidecar has 14 of 40 subdimensions at 1 and 26 at 2 (measured 16.3 vs published 17.2). The pre-march crackdown (roads sealed, Islamabad schools used to house police, Imran Khan's sisters detained under the Maintenance of Public Order ordinance, reported 2026-09-24) bears on A4, B2, B5, I1 and I4, all already at 1 or 2 with the same class of conduct (pre-protest detention of PTI figures) scored in July-August. No anchor moves. Confirmed at 17.2.

results.name: Barrick Gold
results.key_finding: Positive but routine. Barrick reached a collective agreement with Loulo-Gounkoto unions on 2026-09-21 (reported 2026-09-27/28, Miningmx), averting a strike over overtime pay, expense reimbursement and non-implementation of labour agreements. The grievances themselves show prior non-implementation. Even the most generous reading (I3 and B1 from 2 to 3) yields 20.0, which stays Critical (<=20). No band crossing is reachable, and the 3e-bis upgrade test requires more than a strike-averting wage deal. Confirmed at 18.8; watch for implementation. Mining Weekly returned 403; Miningmx used.

results.name: Cornell University
results.key_finding: First baseline: NY Attorney General reviewing Cornell's response to a 2024 fraternity gang-rape allegation; no acknowledgment of failure; protest-suspension pattern criticised by its own Faculty Senate; strong need-based aid credited.

results.name: Kingston
results.key_finding: Attribution, as on 2026-09-24: the 2026-09-18 police killing of Amani Malcolm in Denham Town and the protest response are Jamaica Constabulary Force conduct, referred to INDECOM; they belong to the Jamaica country row, not the municipal row (Kingston and St Andrew Municipal Corporation). This is the same incident screened on 2026-09-24. No municipal conduct located. Recommend the next Jamaica cycle absorb it.

results.name: Tennessee
results.key_finding: Second failed execution of 2026 (Christa Pike, 30 September) led the governor to halt executions and order a third-party review (credited); repeat failure after the 2022 overhaul lowers Systemic Learning 3 -> 2.

results.name: Somalia
results.key_finding: Near-floor: 32 of 40 subdimensions at 1 (2026-08-20 measured 5.0 vs published 4.7). The UN humanitarian coordinator's 2026-09-28 warning on Baidoa displacement and child malnutrition and the IPC projection (about 26,000 displaced at risk of famine by year-end, reported 2026-09-23) describe conflict conditions already scored at floor in AWR, EQU and BND. No anchor has room to fall in the affected subdimensions. Confirmed.

results.name: Myanmar
results.key_finding: Scanner flag (a) verified: the 2026-09-28 airstrike on the India Market beneath the Kisapanadi Bridge in Kyauktaw, Rakhine State (Al Jazeera 2026-09-28: at least 33 killed; later reports 49-50) is a 2026 event, distinct from the 2025-09-12 Thayet Thapin school strike in the same township (ledger myanmar-rakhine-airstrike). It corroborates the floor. Myanmar is at 0.0 with all 40 subdimensions at 1 (2026-08-20); no movement is possible. Confirmed.

results.name: University of Glasgow
results.key_finding: First baseline of the rank-1 university: slavery-reparations work credited at anchor 4, but arms divestment overridden against 81%/86% consultation support and BAE protest coordination reported; adverse sources too low-tier for a band crossing, so flag-for-review.

results.name: University of Birmingham
results.key_finding: First baseline: latest redundancy round falls entirely on migrant/minority-ethnic staff with the equality impact assessment withheld; 39.4 is 0.6 below the band line on tier-1/2 sources, so flag-for-review.

results.name: OpenAI
results.key_finding: Allegation, not finding. Florida's Attorney General filed a motion for a temporary injunction on 2026-09-28 seeking to pause new model development absent independent safety guardrails and to bar Florida minors from ChatGPT. No court has ruled. OpenAI was fully assessed 2026-09-20 (measured 25.0 vs published 22.5) and the minor-safety concerns underlying the filing are already scored there (B5, A5, I4). Confirmed; re-check on any ruling.

results.name: Laos
results.key_finding: No state conduct established. RFA (2026-09-25) reports Lao content creator Khieo Lapchanh, a government critic, went missing in Thailand's Samut Sakhon province a day before his UNHCR asylum interview; the Manushya Foundation suggests transnational repression. No Lao government involvement is documented. The HRW World Report 2026 Laos chapter URL returned 404. Laos (14.1) has never been assessed; a first baseline should be run in rotation alongside Vietnam (proposal filed this cycle) and Cambodia for regional consistency. Not stamped.

results.name: Vietnam
results.key_finding: First baseline: two foreign Viet Tan activists detained (abduction from Cambodia alleged); 160+ political prisoners (HRW); health-care expansion and partial death-penalty abolition credited; 23.8.

results.name: United States
results.key_finding: The 2026-09-29 Supreme Court stay lets the administration resume third-country deportations pending December argument. The deportation practice itself was scored on 2026-09-17 (measured 16.3 vs published 17.5; 14 subdimensions at 1). The stay is interim court action, not a merits finding, and does not add new conduct beyond what was scored. Confirmed.

results.name: Northwestern University
results.key_finding: The ACLU / Amnesty International USA report (released 2026-09-23; Daily Northwestern 2026-09-29) cites Northwestern for the Thrasher suspension and tenure denial, removal of a Jewish Voice for Peace banner, and the November 2025 $75M federal settlement revoking the Deering Meadow Agreement. Thrasher and the settlement were scored on 2026-07-22 and 2026-08-01 (measured 42.5 vs published 42.2). The banner removal is minor and does not move A4, E3 or I4 (already 2). Corroborates; confirmed.

results.name: Meta Platforms
results.key_finding: Near-floor: 27 of 40 subdimensions at 1 (2026-08-26 measured 8.1 vs published 7.8). The 2026-09-25 Santa Fe jury verdict (Facebook deceived users about privacy) is a court finding, but the subdimensions it bears on (AB1, AB3, B5, I4) are already at 1, and the penalty phase is pending. Confirmed; re-check after remedies.

results.name: Madrid
results.key_finding: First baseline of the municipal row: the city's housing offer and EMVS mediation for the evicted 87-year-old credited (AC1 = 4); annual homeless count and +18% places credited; Canada Real power cuts (shared responsibility) and the unassessed 65.6 bring it to 48.1.

results.name: New York City
results.key_finding: More than 100 arrests at a 2026-09-24 sit-in blocking a road outside UN headquarters (Al Jazeera, 2026-09-25) is routine enforcement against civil disobedience; no excessive-force finding located. Not score-moving. CROSS-INDEX FLAG: the same city is published at 48.4 (global-cities, never assessed) and 56.3 (us-cities, assessed 2026-06-10). A first baseline for the global-cities row should reuse the us-cities evidence so the two do not diverge. Not stamped.

results.name: South Africa
results.key_finding: Refugees report police refused to open cases before the 30 September anti-migrant deadline; first 40-subdimension scoring gives 41.3, but most of the gap re-reads evidence the May baseline already weighed, so not filed (calibration flag).
results.withheld_reason: 3e-bis check 5 (calibration is not a one-off proposal). The 2026-05-07 first agent baseline confirmed 50.0 on largely the same 2025 evidence (Operation Dudula, the July 2025 infant death, whistleblower killings, the Madlanga Commission). Of the -8.7 measured here, only about -2.5 is attributable to new June-September 2026 conduct (A5, E1, E4, B4); the rest is a different reading of evidence already weighed in May. Encoding that as a one-off downgrade would relitigate a documented baseline. Recorded as flag-for-review for coordinator calibration instead.

results.name: Cambodia
results.key_finding: The alleged abduction of Hiep Tran and Duc Thuan Nguyen on Cambodian soil (ABC 2026-09-29) is alleged Vietnamese conduct and is scored on the Vietnam row this cycle. Cambodian complicity is not alleged in fetched sources. Cambodia (12.5) is near floor (2026-07-24: 23 subdimensions at 1). Confirmed.

results.name: Bangladesh
results.key_finding: Three September 2026 laws strip the human rights commission of power to investigate enforced disappearances and keep the Rapid Action Battalion intact under a new name (HRW 2026-09-22); 33.1 vs 39.8.

results.name: Turkey
results.key_finding: The 2026-09-12 to 14 raids on LGBT groups (HRW 2026-09-18) were scored in the 2026-09-18 assessment (measured 7.5 vs published 10.3; confirmation). No new in-window conduct beyond it. Confirmed.

results.name: Iran
results.key_finding: The UN Fact-Finding Mission's 2026-09-21 crimes-against-humanity finding was corroborated in the 2026-09-21 near-floor note. The 2026-09-27 sentencing of journalist Abbas Abdi and suspension of Etemad add press-freedom conduct in subdimensions already at 1 (Iran 2.5; 36 of 40 at 1). Confirmed.

results.name: Hong Kong
results.key_finding: The 2026-09-30 arrest of Boom News founder Tang Ho-wing on suspicion of sedition bears on A4, B2, AB3, I1 and I4, all already at 1 in the 2026-09-14 assessment (which reconstructs exactly to the published 26.9). No anchor has room to fall. Confirmed.

calibration_flags_for_coordinator.detail: Glasgow (rank 1, 62.5) and Cornell (rank 12, 54.7) measured 48.7 and 41.9 on first baselines; Birmingham (43.0) measured 39.4. The universities index top ranks appear to rest on unassessed values. Recommend a cohort first-baseline pass rather than one-off moves.
Valencia (60.9 -> 41.9) and Madrid (65.6 -> 48.1) both measured about 18 points below unassessed values on municipal-only evidence. Review together.

South Africa: the May 2026 dimension-level baseline (50.0) vs the first subdimension-level scoring (41.3) on mostly the same evidence. Decide whether dimension-level baselines without sidecars should be re-run at subdimension level.
New York City is 48.4 in global-cities (never assessed) and 56.3 in us-cities (assessed 2026-06-10). Align.
Vietnam measured 23.8 (from 34.4); Laos 14.1 (never assessed) and Cambodia 12.5 remain. Re-baseline together.

band_crossing_evidence_rule: Glasgow and Birmingham crossings are filed as flag-for-review because no adverse source at sourceTier >= 4 was located. Madrid and Valencia crossings meet the rule via tier-5 municipal sources and, for Madrid, the ECSR treaty-body decision (reported by FEANTSA; coe.int returned 403).
